bio.text: Nancy Mannion is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 11th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.

In her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses, she describes herself as a registered nurse and healthcare leader who worked for decades as an emergency nurse and as an international healthcare consultant.
Ballotpedia lists her education as a bachelor's degree from Salem State College (1988) and a graduate degree from the University of Maryland School of Nursing (1995).
